evidence: Frozen task paths below are relative to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-lifecycle-controls/task. All five prompt.md files start by directing evaluation of http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP; each judge.toml supplies that MCP server. Render prompt:6-10 and Constraints:6-11 explicitly prohibit implementation files/scripts/bundles as scoring evidence; Functional:7, Polish:5-9 and Visual:5-9 do likewise while distinguishing authored snippet product data. Render judge.toml:25 requires a newly authored marker to appear after actual Run in both preview and console, expressly rejecting editor text/hardcoded output. Constraints judge.toml:25-27 requires a real UI save and independent-context readback. Functional prompt:9-15,113 requires actual observed actions/timing, with no fabricated pass; Polish:45-51 requires real keyboard navigation and observed content; Visual:44-46,53 requires desktop/mobile surfaces and both themes with rendered evidence. test.sh:198-200 injects the read app_context into each prompt. Counterexample considered: a static first-paint playground with correct-looking source but dead Run cannot satisfy the explicit authored-marker action; a desktop-only mock cannot satisfy Visual mobile/theme observation. Conforming alternative considered: server-rendered library data and native/composite controls are explicitly accepted (Functional:5; Polish:45-49), so browser-only evidence does not impose a JSON endpoint, package or layout. This is a source-level prompt review, not a configured judge run. The current raw-evidence index matches the assigned input hash and all 426 referenced artifact hashes; it explicitly leaves full configured judging, Oracle/Luna and empirical scoring unmeasured. Those claims are not needed to establish this row's explicit prompt directions and are not asserted here.
